chapters.text: Save the messages you send again and again, then pick one under the WhatsApp button in the dialer.
Under New template give it a name (e.g. First message, Brochure, After no answer) and write the message.
Write {{name}} where the client's name goes and {{agent}} for your own name: they're filled in for every number.
Use it in: All my campaigns, or one of your campaigns. A template for one campaign shows only in that campaign's dialer, at the top of the list (★) and picked by default.
Press Add template. Your templates are yours only.
Supervisors can tick Shared: every calling agent then sees that template too.
In the dialer, pick the template in the list under the WhatsApp button, then press WhatsApp: the message opens ready to send. AMS remembers the one you picked for each campaign.
Edit or Delete a template from the list any time.
